name: identity_and_features
sql: SELECT current_database() AS database_name,current_user AS management_role,current_setting('transaction_read_only') AS read_only,(SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='meta_ads' AND table_name LIKE 'unified%') AS unified_tables

name: products
sql: SELECT p.name,p.display_name,p.is_active,(SELECT count(*) FROM meta_ads.product_cost_rules c WHERE c.product_id=p.id) AS cost_rules FROM meta_ads.products p ORDER BY p.sort_order,p.name LIMIT 150

name: coupang_products
sql: SELECT standard_name,display_name,is_active FROM meta_ads.coupang_products ORDER BY sort_order,standard_name LIMIT 150

name: connections
sql: SELECT id,provider,display_name,shop_key,currency_code,time_zone,access_state,enabled FROM meta_ads.source_connections ORDER BY provider,id LIMIT 50

name: policies
sql: SELECT connection_id,data_kind,from_date,to_date,primary_source FROM meta_ads.source_policies ORDER BY connection_id,data_kind,from_date LIMIT 100

name: public_inventory
sql: SELECT table_name,string_agg(column_name,',' ORDER BY ordinal_position) AS columns FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name IN ('stores','canonical_sales_units','order_source_signatures','costs','cost_rules','order_sync_states') GROUP BY table_name

name: naver_units
sql: SELECT id,payload->>'storeId' AS store_id,payload->>'name' AS name,payload->>'isActive' AS active,payload->>'groupId' AS group_id,payload->'aliases' AS aliases,payload->'costs' AS costs FROM public.canonical_sales_units ORDER BY id LIMIT 150

name: naver_payload_keys
sql: SELECT 'unit' AS kind,jsonb_object_keys(payload) AS key FROM (SELECT payload FROM public.canonical_sales_units LIMIT 1) s UNION ALL SELECT 'order',jsonb_object_keys(payload) FROM (SELECT payload FROM public.order_items LIMIT 1) s UNION ALL SELECT 'sync',jsonb_object_keys(payload) FROM (SELECT payload FROM public.order_sync_states LIMIT 1) s UNION ALL SELECT 'ad',jsonb_object_keys(payload) FROM (SELECT payload FROM public.ad_campaign_daily_costs LIMIT 1) s UNION ALL SELECT 'upload',jsonb_object_keys(payload) FROM (SELECT payload FROM public.ad_excel_uploads LIMIT 1) s

name: indexes
sql: SELECT schemaname,tablename,indexdef FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname IN ('public','meta_ads') AND tablename IN ('order_items','ad_campaign_daily_costs','canonical_sales_units','order_sync_states','meta_adset_daily_metrics','google_campaign_daily_costs','cafe24_order_lines','coupang_sale_lines','coupang_ad_metrics') ORDER BY schemaname,tablename,indexname

name: runtime_access
sql: SELECT r.rolname,n.nspname,c.relname,c.relrowsecurity,has_schema_privilege(r.oid,n.oid,'USAGE') AS schema_usage,has_table_privilege(r.oid,c.oid,'SELECT') AS table_select,has_any_column_privilege(r.oid,c.oid,'SELECT') AS any_column_select FROM pg_roles r CROSS JOIN pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE r.rolname IN ('meta_ads_app','meta_ads_prod_runtime') AND n.nspname='public' AND c.relname IN ('stores','order_items','canonical_sales_units','order_source_signatures','ad_campaign_daily_costs','ad_excel_uploads','daily_fake_purchases','order_sync_states','daily_sales_unit_profits','daily_store_summaries') ORDER BY r.rolname,c.relname
